items.difficulty_reason: A structural adaptation of an inversion induction to the proof system with cut: every case of the underlying inversion proof must be re-verified against two extra invariants (proof height and the number and ranks of cut inferences), and the genuinely new cut case needs the recombination derivation; the bookkeeping discipline across all cases is the difficulty.
